features.title: Why SimplyBuilder?
features.desc: A lightweight, declarative way to build UI components and pages using SimplyBuilder Objects.

cards.d: Describe your interface in natural language or paste HTML — AI agents use SimplyBuilder skills to produce the Struct for you.
Import CoreModule from any CDN or install via npm — works with Vite, Webpack, or any bundler. Zero config either way.
A powerful schema for SimplyBuilder Objects describing any DOM tree: element, type, attr, attrNS, dataset, children, text, html, shadow, and events.
SimplyBuilder provides skills and specs so AI agents can generate Structs from natural language, HTML, or URLs. You describe, AI builds.
Every SimplyBuilder Object is validated against the ElementStruct schema before rendering.
MIT-licensed. Contribute on GitHub, report issues, and help shape the future of declarative UI with SimplyBuilder.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.desc: Learn how SimplyBuilder Objects work. The entire UI is described as a Struct — a plain JS object that maps directly to DOM.
docs.packages_desc: Each module ships with its own README covering installation, usage, and the full API. Open the one you need:

packages.core_desc: Unified entry point. Imports and wires the DOM and Event modules together — element store, struct rendering, event actions.
packages.dom_desc: Element creation and DOM manipulation. Build HTML and SVG trees from structs, register them in the element store, and clean them up.
packages.event_desc: Declarative event management. Register named actions, bind them through the event property, and free listeners on removal.

docs.schema_text: Each node supports: element, type, attr, attrNS, dataset, text, html, shadow, event, and children.
docs.schema_props_desc: Each node in a SimplyBuilder Object can use the following properties:

props.element_d: The HTML tag name. This is the only required property. Examples: div, button, section, h1, p, ul, li.
props.attr_d: Key-value pairs of standard HTML attributes. Used for class, id, href, style, and more.
props.text_d: Sets the element's textContent. Plain text only — no HTML parsing.
props.html_d: Sets the element's innerHTML. Use for rich content with HTML tags.
props.dataset_d: Key-value pairs for data-* attributes. A special state key auto-registers the element in the store for later retrieval.
props.children_d: Array of child ElementStruct objects. Builds the DOM tree recursively.
props.svg_d: Set type to 'svg' and use attrNS for SVG namespace attributes. Enables inline SVG rendering.
props.shadow_d: Creates a Shadow Root on the element. Accepts a string ('open'|'closed') or an object with mode and optional styles.
props.event_d: Binds a DOM event to a registered action. Requires type (event name) and action (registered handler name).
